top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 110, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Fyn Rundt (Tour of Funen)'s mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Fyn Rundt (Tour of Funen)'s demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Fyn Rundt (Tour of Funen). Train it until it feels boring.

Road-specific control matters at Fyn Rundt (Tour of Funen). Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 110 miles.
At Fyn Rundt (Tour of Funen), changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Fyn Rundt (Tour of Funen)'s mixed terrain actually does to you.
110 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 110 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 110 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.

race_overlay.weather: May in Funen Island, Denmark (2026: start/finish in Middelfart). Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Fyn Rundt (Tour of Funen). Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Fyn Rundt (Tour of Funen)’s 110 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 110 miles of mixed terrain in Funen Island, Denmark (2026: start/finish in Middelfart).
